POST_domain_scoring_run_API.details: POST /api/admin/domain-scoring/run analyzes all domains with 5+ results and creates alerts based on thresholds. Returns alerts_created, alerts_updated, summary counts, and thresholds.

GET_domain_alerts_API.details: GET /api/admin/domain-alerts returns list of alerts with id, domain, alert_level, avg_score, result_count, min_score, max_score, message, dismissed status. Supports include_dismissed and alert_level query params.

POST_dismiss_alert_API.details: POST /api/admin/domain-alerts/{id}/dismiss marks alert as dismissed. Returns success message.

POST_block_from_alert_API.details: POST /api/admin/domain-alerts/{id}/block adds domain to blocklist, removes search results, and dismisses alert. Returns results_removed count.

DELETE_clear_dismissed_API.details: DELETE /api/admin/domain-alerts/clear-dismissed removes all dismissed alerts. Returns deleted_count.
